## Activity

East City Eye Clinic recorded 199 captures during January 2026. Activity was completed as part of the routine service and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below. The recorded volume represents all captures submitted by the clinic during the month.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for assessment. There were 4 ungradable captures, giving an ungradable rate of 2.0 per cent. These images could not be used for a grading outcome. The result should continue to be monitored through routine review of capture practice, with attention to image acquisition and the factors that may affect the usability of submitted images.

## Grading

Grading identified 50 referable results during January 2026. The median lag between capture and grading was 2 days. This indicates the typical interval for results to proceed from image capture to completion of grading. The activity, image-quality, and grading measures should be reviewed together as part of ongoing site monitoring. The reported results provide a concise summary of service delivery at East City Eye Clinic for the month.
